content.content: jj parentage is version control only: no edge is ever derived from it. Navigation reads nodes and edges alone. Edge targets resolve to sibling node files, except zzzzzzzz, which resolves to the root.
content.rationale: Rebases rewire parentage constantly; a graph that followed it would drift meaning under routine maintenance. So the version control layer may rearrange which change sits above which without moving the graph, and what a traversal follows is recorded in node files alone: a reader needs no VCS state to walk the decision graph. Resolving a target to its sibling file keeps that reading off the tree's arrangement too, and the single exception names the root, which has no node to point at.
